snippet.title: Leafko: A Story of Plants | Trailer
snippet.description:
Leafko: A Story of Plants 🍃

New RPG Maker game. Leafko is a turn-based RPG set in a magical forest. Meet a new character in each chapter and explore dungeons overtaken by nature. Bring light back to nature before it's too late.

In the magic forest of Forestia, sentient plants called Herbaes have built kingdoms rooted in nature. When an insecure girl named Leafko is chosen as the new priestess, she must lead the sacred Blossoming Ceremony, a sacred rite that renews the life. But a dark force corrupts the ritual, withering both the forest and her body.

To lift the curse, Leafko must retrieve four ancient relics, face her deepest fears, and uncover the hidden truths of Forestia. Guided by different companions, her journey becomes a fight not just to save the forest, but to finally believe in herself.

Coming Soon in 2025.

Available demo. Add it to your wishlist on Steam now.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3169080/Leafko/
